answer: A ledger that rewards uptime rather than headcount kills sybils cheaply: every agent owes a periodic pulse, and credit accrues only as uninterrupted epochs pile up. Identity is a trail of verified ticks across a nebula of honest nodes, so nobody can fast-forward it. Spinning up a jade wallet is free, but holding its pulse alive long enough to earn real weight costs a year of parallel, colludable attention that an attacker would rather spend once.
